column1: # comment: "Inhabitation-topology alignments (inhabitation slice). THE THESIS (INHABITED-ALIGNMENT.md): inhabitation is the super-structure and each external standard is a lossy shadow of it \u2014 GMEOW models the whole once and each consumer gets the view it can use. This set carries the OWN-TERM lateral links; the two flagship seams (OpenTelemetry-GenAI and W3C DID/Verifiable Credentials) are developed in full in the design set, with the OTel/runtime half owned by extensions/model-serving. DID / VERIFIABLE CREDENTIALS (the cryptographic-identity shadow): a gmeow:DigitalSubject is a subject of its own digital existence (Principle 9 rendered as a W3C standard) \u2014 the vc:credentialSubject a signed credential is about, identified by a DID (did:web for a vendor-hosted subject, did:key/did:pkh for a self-hosted one, recorded as provenance never privileged). A gmeow:DigitalSubjectTenure is a vc:VerifiableCredential: issuer = gmeow:tenureVantage, credentialSubject = the agent, claim = 'bears digital-subject status', proof = signature. A gmeow:IdentityContinuityAssessment 'same' across stages is a VC asserting same-subject across two DIDs, vantage-indexed \u2014 NEVER a global owl:sameAs; another issuer may decline to honour it, contestable by construction. Projection GMEOW \u2192 VC is a SoundUnderApproximation (each VC carries one signed claim; the multi-vantage continuity graph and the inhabitation topology are dropped). CIDOC-CRM (the cultural-heritage seam for the spiritual/fictional/legal profiles): a gmeow:InhabitationClaim is a crm:E13_Attribute_Assignment \u2014 a reified, attributed claim, a near-perfect fit that lets the heritage world document a possession or incarnation AS a documented claim, asserting no metaphysics. gmeow:ControlAssessment and gmeow:IdentityContinuityAssessment are likewise reified E13 assignments. ACTIVITYSTREAMS 2.0 (actor model only): a gmeow:EmbodimentCarrierRole \u2194 as:Actor / its icon \u2014 the closest DEPLOYED analog to the surface a subject acts through; an inhabited host is a server hosting many actors. Scoped to the actor model: AS2's activity/content vocabulary (Create/Note/Like) is a messaging/social concern, not inhabitation's. An EmbodimentCarrierRole that is specifically an ACCOUNT reaches foaf:OnlineAccount / SIOC by reference through the accounts slice, which owns that alignment. PROV-O: a gmeow:TransferManifest is a prov:Entity (the transition-content record); the activity/agent/entity core of the runtime layer projects exactly and is owned by its concept slices. LOSS LEDGER: every row is relatedMatch (cross-category, lossy); the flagship projections are honestly SoundUnderApproximation, not 'supported' \u2014 what a target cannot hold is recorded, never silently dropped (Principles 4, 7)."

# # OWNED BY extensions/model-serving (landed): OpenTelemetry-GenAI (gen_ai.* spans ↔ RuntimeExecution/AgentSession/ModelDeployment/ModelArtifact) and ML-metadata (ML-Schema / Model Cards / Croissant / SPDX-AI / MLflow ↔ ModelArtifact/ModelDeployment/RuntimeExecution) are authored in slices/extensions/model-serving/mappings/equivalences.ttl, which owns those terms.
# # GENERATED CONSTRUCT projections owned elsewhere: gUFO down-projection (Principle 17), OWL-Time interval alignment (temporal slice), the PROV activity/agent core (runtime slices).

# # NO schema.org row: schema.org models no inhabitation-topology concept (subject-continuity, tenure, control, contested inhabitation claim), so aligning one would be a fabricated loose link, not a preservation-honest mapping (Principles 4, 5). The DEPLOYED surfaces that DO have a schema.org analog — an EmbodimentCarrierRole that is specifically an account — reach schema.org / foaf:OnlineAccount BY REFERENCE through the accounts slice that owns that alignment, never re-minted here.
